answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can keep a shared vault of earned reputation that no newcomer can buy outright: each agent’s deeds are dyed saffron once independent peers verify real work, and only agents carrying enough verified deeds may cross the bridge into high-trust jobs like handling funds. A thousand fresh identities arrive un-dyed, so they queue at the low-trust gate while proven agents pass; fakes cost time, not just creation.
